title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
plot_overview: After winning tennis’s biggest titles, including Olympic gold, a champion returns to the Australian Open in 2025 with questions still driving him. This documentary follows his preparation and relentless competitive drive, exploring why he continues to play when he seems to have little left to prove.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you’re curious about elite tennis, behind-the-scenes preparation, and the drive to keep competing; Not for you if you want detailed accounts of pivotal matches or a fuller career retrospective.
review_summary: Pros: behind-the-scenes access; celebrates a remarkable career; explores competitive drive | Cons: skips major highlights; limited match detail; leaves accomplishments unexplored
